title: Reconstruct partial SSE transcripts and introduce smart-retry middleware for transient disconnects
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Several customers across Hosted, Dedicated and Private deployments reported recurring partial outputs from the SSE (server-sent events) streaming API after transient network disconnects. The common symptom: client receives an apparently complete transcript but the final few tokens are missing and the stream closes without the finalization marker. Customers that verify output integrity (financial summarizers, legal redaction flows) observed truncated outputs leading to incorrect downstream state.

Scope: incident affects any model and route that uses streaming (text/chat) with prefix/KV-cache enabled and gateway edge proxies. Initial reports came from two enterprise customers on Dedicated (high throughput) and a Hosted customer doing long-form generation. This ticket tracks RCA, a short-term mitigation, SDK resume behavior changes, and a longer-term protocol improvement to ensure deterministic finalization of streamed transcripts.
comments: 2026-03-01 - Aisha Patel: Initial triage. Reproduced locally hitting edge proxy with artificial 300-700ms backend jitter. Observed connection close from gateway when backend sent final chunk > 2s after last token. SDKs currently rely on a trailing "final-token" sentinel which is sometimes lost on abrupt socket close. Opening as P0 due to customer escalations.

2026-03-02 - Marco Ruiz: Enabled enhanced streaming telemetry (seq numbers, per-chunk checksums, last-offset markers) in canary env. Added logging for gateway close reason and backend flush times. Found spikes correlated with KV cache eviction and model tail-latency bursts on Dedicated pools.

2026-03-03 - Marco Ruiz: Short-term mitigation implemented: gateway will now hold a 5s drain window for any stream in which the backend signalled "potential-final" but hasn't sent final chunk. This reduces truncation at the cost of small connection hold. Deployed to hosted-canary. Observed reduction in truncation for test runs (from 14% down to 1.2% for simulated jitter).

2026-03-04 - Design review (infra/infra-ops): confirmed drain window is acceptable for Hosted but may need config knob for Dedicated with strict SLA on connection churn. Added gate to allow tenant-level override for Dedicated/Private.

2026-03-05 - QA: New e2e test added (sse-long-tail-replay) that simulates delayed final chunk and verifies client receives trailing sentinel or SDK resumes cleanly. Tests failing on older SDK versions; created SDK patch to interpret sequence numbers and perform resume handshake.

2026-03-06 - Marco Ruiz: Drafted runtime PR to add explicit finalization commit event (stream.commit) that is idempotent and survives retransmit. PR: runtime/pull/4289. Includes change to edge protocol and backward-compatible flag so older SDKs continue to work for now.
2026-03-07 - Customer comms: Sent interim mitigation note to affected customers describing drain window and suggested SDK upgrade. Opened scheduled upgrade for Dedicated tenants with operations team.

2026-03-08 - SDK team (PR sdk-js/pull/332): Added smart-retry middleware that, upon ambiguous close, performs a resume handshake using opaque session id + last-seq. If server responds that final commit exists, SDK fetches remaining tokens and concatenates deterministically. Added backoff jitter to avoid thundering herd.

2026-03-09 - Observability: Created dashboard tile for "stream finalization failures" (ratio of streams closed without final commit) and alert threshold set at 0.5% over 10m across hosted. Added tenant-level alerting for Dedicated where threshold is 0.1%.

2026-03-10 - Marco Ruiz: Merged runtime PR to canary; merging SDK patch to staged release. Next steps: run two-week canary, roll runtime->stable and then recommend SDK upgrade in release notes. Also schedule follow-up to harden kernel path that caused tail latency spike (ENG-646002).
